basic_details.job_title: HAL Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for 2 Graduate Apprenticeship, Diploma Apprenticeship Posts
basic_details.short_information: Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL), Transport Aircraft Division, Kanpur is engaging Graduate (Degree) and Diploma Apprentices for the year 2026-27 under the Apprentices Act-1961, in 11 degree branches and 11 diploma branches, for candidates who passed in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. The stipend is payable as per the Apprentices Act-1961, and selection is purely on the marks of the degree or diploma. Candidates must register on the NATS 2.0 portal and send the prescribed application form by Ordinary Post, Speed Post or Courier so that it reaches the Technical Training Institute, HAL Kanpur

qualification.details: Each branch needs the degree or diploma shown against it in the tables above. In addition, the notice sets these conditions: | The Diploma/Degree course must have been passed in the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. The candidate should possess the Diploma/Degree Pass Certificate as on the date of application. Candidates with status "Appearing" or "Result awaited" are not eligible. Candidates with pending Back Papers, or whose Supplementary Exam results are awaited, are also not eligible. Registration on the NATS 2.0 portal ( www.nats.education.gov.in ) is required; candidates registered on the NATS 1.0 portal will not be considered. | Check the official notification for the exact branch-wise eligibility of each apprenticeship.

salary_details.details: Stipend will be payable to Diploma/Degree Apprentices as per the Apprentices Act-1961 (as amended from time to time); the notice does not print a stipend amount. The engagement is apprenticeship training for the year 2026-27 under the Apprentices Act-1961; the length of the training is not specified in the notice.

selection_process: Selection of apprentices shall be made strictly on the basis of 100% merit
taking into consideration 100% weightage of the total aggregate marks secured in the Degree / Diploma examination. Provisionally selected candidates will be informed through India Post
and will then come to TTI
Kanpur for the further selection process; no TA/DA is payable for this visit. Mere submission of an application does not give a right to take part in the selection process
and the decision of HAL Kanpur on eligibility will be final.

Selected candidates should possess an online Character Certificate (issued by SSP/DCP/SP) and a Medical Certificate (in the format provided by HAL) issued by the Chief Medical Officer or an authorised Medical Officer of the District Hospital
as per the address in their Domicile Certificate / Aadhar only.
how_to_apply: Register on the NATS 2.0 portal (www.nats.education.gov.in) to get the Apprenticeship Registration Number.
Note the registration number, registered e-mail and registered mobile number; the application form asks for all three.
Download the prescribed application form, which is available on the HAL website along with the notification. Applications in any other format will be summarily rejected.
Tick Graduate (Degree) Apprenticeship or Diploma Apprenticeship and select your branch from the list in the form.
Fill in every detail; your name, father's name, mother's name and date of birth must be as per the 10th / High School Certificate.
Give the total and obtained marks and the percentage up to 2 decimal places; CGPA must be converted to an equivalent percentage, with the conversion formula of your Board/University.
Paste a recent 3.5 x 2.5 cm photograph on the form, tick the enclosure checklist, and sign the declaration with date and place.
Enclose self-attested copies of the documents listed below.

Send the form by Ordinary Post, Speed Post or Courier Service to: The Chief Manager, Technical Training Institute, Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd., Transport Aircraft Division, Post office- Chakeri, Distt. - Kanpur, Pin code – 208008.
Make sure it reaches by 07 December 2026 (1640 hrs). No application will be accepted by hand or in person, or after the last date.
Mandatory attachments (self-attested copies):
High School (Class X) Marks Sheet
High School (Class X) Certificate
Diploma/Degree Mark Sheet
Diploma/Degree Certificate / Provisional Certificate
NATS 2.0 portal registered Profile for Diploma / Degree Apprenticeship, showing the Apprenticeship Registration No.
Aadhar card and PAN card
Domicile Certificate (issued after 01/04/2023 only)
12-digit APAAR (Automated Permanent Academic Account Registry) Id
Optional attachments (if applicable):
Caste Certificate (SC/ST/OBC-NCL); for OBC (NCL), the certificate should not be older than 3 years from the date of the notification
PwD (Person with Disabilities) Certificate
EWS Certificate, valid for the current FY 2026-27
HAL Employee (Serving/ Retired/ Deceased) Ward Certificate, issued by the HR Department of the concerned HAL Division

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only Indian Nationals are eligible to apply. Each branch needs the degree or diploma shown against it in the tables above. In addition, the notice sets these conditions: The Diploma/Degree course must have been passed in the years 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025 or 2026. The candidate should possess the Diploma/Degree Pass Certificate as on the date of application. Candidates with status "Appearing" or "Result awaited" are not eligible. Candidates with pending Back Papers, or whose Supplementary Exam results are awaited, are also not eligible. Registration on the NATS 2.0 portal ( www.nats.education.gov.in ) is required; candidates registered on the NATS 1.0 portal will not be considered. Check the official notification for the exact branch-wise eligibility of each apprenticeship. The candidate should be a minimum of 18 years of age, and the maximum age is 27 years as on 31 October 2026. Relaxation is admissible in the respective category as follows: Candidates who have completed or are pursuing Apprenticeship anywhere under The Apprenticeship Act-1961. Candidates who have work experience of one year or more in any organization. Candidates who are "Appearing", whose result is awaited, or who have pending Back Papers or awaited Supplementary results. SC/ST/OBC (NCL)/EWS/PwD/HAL Employee ward candidates will be extended reservation as per Government of India / The Apprenticeship Act-1961 / HAL Rules and Guidelines. Candidates claiming reservation must produce the Caste certificate and Domicile Certificate from the same State, which is either their home State or migrated State. Dependents (Children and Spouse only) of serving, retired or deceased HAL employees must submit the employee's details, duly certified by the Human Resource Department of the respective division.

content_sections.heading: Stipend and Training Period
content_sections.text: Stipend will be payable to Diploma/Degree Apprentices as per the Apprentices Act-1961 (as amended from time to time); the notice does not print a stipend amount. The engagement is apprenticeship training for the year 2026-27 under the Apprentices Act-1961; the length of the training is not specified in the notice.

Fill in every detail; your name, father's name, mother's name and date of birth must be as per the 10th / High School Certificate. Give the total and obtained marks and the percentage up to 2 decimal places; CGPA must be converted to an equivalent percentage, with the conversion formula of your Board/University. Paste a recent 3.5 x 2.5 cm photograph on the form, tick the enclosure checklist, and sign the declaration with date and place. Enclose self-attested copies of the documents listed below. Send the form by Ordinary Post, Speed Post or Courier Service to: The Chief Manager, Technical Training Institute, Hindustan Aeronautics Ltd., Transport Aircraft Division, Post office- Chakeri, Distt. - Kanpur, Pin code – 208008. Make sure it reaches by 07 December 2026 (1640 hrs). No application will be accepted by hand or in person, or after the last date. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date for the HAL Kanpur apprentice application 2026?
faq.answer: The filled application form must reach the Technical Training Institute, HAL Transport Aircraft Division, Kanpur by 07 December 2026 (1640 hrs). No application is accepted after this date.

faq.question: Q2. What qualification is needed for HAL Kanpur Graduate Apprenticeship?
faq.answer: A 4 Years B.E./B.Tech. in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Electronics/Instrumentation, Chemical, Computer Science/IT or Aeronautical/Aerospace Engineering; 1 Years Library Science; or a 3 Years B.Com., B.Sc. or BBA degree from a recognized Board/University, passed in 2022 to 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for HAL Kanpur Diploma Apprenticeship?
faq.answer: A 3 Years Diploma in Mechanical, Electrical, Civil, Electronics/Instrumentation, Chemical, Computer Science/IT or A.M.E., or a 2 Years Diploma in Library Science, Pharmacy, MOM & SP or Hotel Management & Catering Technology, passed in 2022 to 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for HAL Kanpur apprentice 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 18 years and the maximum is 27 years as on 31 October 2026, with relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST, 3 years for OBC (NCL) and 10 years for PwD candidates.

faq.question: Q5. How much stipend will HAL Kanpur apprentices get?
faq.answer: The stipend is payable to Diploma/Degree Apprentices as per the Apprentices Act-1961, as amended from time to time.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the HAL Kanpur apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Register on NATS 2.0, download the prescribed form from the HAL website, fill it, attach self-attested documents and send it by Ordinary Post, Speed Post or Courier to The Chief Manager, Technical Training Institute, HAL, Transport Aircraft Division, Post office- Chakeri, Distt. - Kanpur, Pin code – 208008.

faq.question: Q7. How will HAL Kanpur select apprentices?
faq.answer: Selection is strictly on 100% merit, based on 100% weightage of the total aggregate marks in the Degree / Diploma examination. Provisionally selected candidates are informed through India Post, Email or Telephone.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply if I am registered only on NATS 1.0?
faq.answer: No. Registration must be on the NATS 2.0 portal only; candidates registered on the NATS 1.0 portal will not be considered.

faq.question: Q9. Who is not eligible for HAL Kanpur apprenticeship?
faq.answer: Candidates who have completed or are pursuing apprenticeship under the Apprenticeship Act-1961, those with one year or more of work experience, and those who are appearing, awaiting results or have pending back or supplementary papers are not eligible.

faq.question: Q10. Can I hand over the application form in person at HAL Kanpur?
faq.answer: No. Application forms will not be accepted by hand or individually; they must be sent by Ordinary Post, Speed Post or Courier Service.
